implementation.failure: Missing or incompatible package/Skill pauses the entire task before section 1; offer the minimal install prompt and resume only after verification. Service/feature failures pause without native-generation fallback.

evidence: Canonical sealseek-media 0.6.1 CLI/Skill and live capabilities inspected; paid generation and full host flow not tested.
